name: XWUI Layer Stack
description: A layer stack: panels laid on glowing, tilted planes stacked in 3D (the first lowest), each named by a label with a line in its hue on the end side. For showing that several views are the same thing, e.g. one flow as a node graph, BPMN and a flowchart. Each panel is an element placed on its layer; on a narrow screen the planes lie flat in a column.

tiltX.description: Plane tilt about the x axis, degrees.

tiltZ.description: Plane turn about the z axis, degrees.

viewHeight.description: Height of the drawing in pixels.

className.description: Additional CSS class name for the component

panels.description: One element per layer, drawn on it.

uid.description: Auto-assigned unique instance id (injected by the base component, not user content).
